value.rationale: Deletion of the unique highest positive root of the transitive-tournament directed-edge polytope is a canonical geometric mutation. The exact hyperplane dissection turns a difficult change of polytope volume into one explicit (m-1)-crosspolytope, exposing a simple nontrivial 2-power law in every dimension. The local deletion geometry is useful for studying vertex-removal invariants and understanding global Catalan volumes; it is not simply recomputation of an existing whole-polytope volume.
